metadata.name: Marketing Studio
metadata.description: Create campaigns, brand-governed creatives and product mockups from Link with provider-neutral AI generation.
metadata.author: Asteby
features: Save reusable brand kits with your palette, tone and visual rules.
Take each campaign from brief to review, approval and publishing.
Review every creative with moderation that is separate from approval.
Request AI images with a monthly quota and the real cost of each job.
Mark which product photos are authorized to be used in mockups.
Works with the image generator you install, such as Nano Banana (Gemini).

es.name: Estudio de Marketing
es.description: Crea campañas, piezas gobernadas por marca y mockups de producto desde Link con generación de IA desacoplada del proveedor.
features: Guarda kits de marca reutilizables con tu paleta, tono y reglas visuales.
Lleva cada campaña del brief a la revisión, la aprobación y la publicación.
Revisa cada pieza con una moderación separada de la aprobación.
Pide imágenes con IA con una cuota mensual y el costo real de cada trabajo.
Marca qué fotos de producto están autorizadas para usarse en mockups.
Funciona con el generador de imágenes que instales, como Nano Banana (Gemini).

en.name: Marketing Studio
en.description: Create campaigns, brand-governed creatives and product mockups from Link with provider-neutral AI generation.
features: Save reusable brand kits with your palette, tone and visual rules.
Take each campaign from brief to review, approval and publishing.
Review every creative with moderation that is separate from approval.
Request AI images with a monthly quota and the real cost of each job.
Mark which product photos are authorized to be used in mockups.
Works with the image generator you install, such as Nano Banana (Gemini).

requires.reason: Optional: generates the images for creatives. Without an image generator installed you can still manage brand kits, campaigns and uploads, but you cannot request AI generations. Generation only completes with connector_nanobanana 0.4.0 or later: earlier versions use the old dot-separated event names (image.generated) and their jobs would stay queued. The minimum will be raised to 0.4.0 once that version is released.

capabilities.reason: Read organization-scoped brand kits, campaigns, product references, creatives, creative versions and generation jobs.
Persist organization-scoped marketing lifecycle, moderation and generation job state.
Ask the installed image generator to produce the image of a queued generation job.
Announce that a campaign was sent to review.
Announce that a campaign was approved.
Announce that a campaign was rejected.
Announce that a campaign was published.
Announce that a campaign was archived.
Announce that a creative passed moderation.
Announce that a creative was rejected in moderation.
Announce that a creative was flagged in moderation.
Announce that a generation job finished with an image.
Announce that a generation job failed.
Ask the installed text provider bridge to write the copy of a creative.
Announce that generated copy was applied to a creative.
Ask the installed brand analyzer bridge to analyze a brand kit.
Announce that a brand analysis was applied to the brand kit.
Announce that a brand analysis failed.
Ask the creative render bridge to compose a still creative.
Ask the creative render bridge to render a motion creative.
Announce that a creative render finished.
Announce that a creative render failed.

Resolve the generation job that an installed image generator (Nano Banana) completed, without this addon ever calling the provider. Needs the generator installed and enabled in the same organization; without it this event never fires, which is not an error.
Resolve the generation job that an installed image generator could not complete (rate_limit, invalid_key, blocked_content or transport_error), under the same optional-dependency rule.

subscriptions.comment: An image generator finished a job: resolve it as completed with the same logic as GenerationJob.complete.
An image generator could not finish a job: resolve it as failed with the same logic as GenerationJob.fail.

columns.name: is_default
columns.label: link_marketing.field.is_default
columns.comment: Default kit pre-selected for new campaigns/creatives in this org. Exactly one should be true; enforced by handle_BrandKit_set_default, not a DB constraint.

columns.name: palette
columns.label: link_marketing.field.palette
columns.comment: Array of {value:'#hex', label?} swatches. First entry is the primary brand color.

columns.name: tone
columns.label: link_marketing.field.tone
columns.comment: Free-text brand voice guidance (formal/playful/technical, forbidden words, etc.) fed verbatim into every generation prompt.

columns.name: visual_rules
columns.label: link_marketing.field.visual_rules
columns.comment: Free-text do/don't rules (logo clear space, forbidden imagery, typography) applied by whichever provider generates on behalf of this kit.

columns.name: brief
columns.label: link_marketing.field.brief
columns.comment: Full creative brief. Copied into every GenerationJob prompt context for this campaign.

columns.name: approved_by
columns.label: link_marketing.field.approved_by
columns.comment: User id captured from the action envelope's actor when handle_Campaign_approve runs.

columns.name: product_id
columns.label: link_marketing.field.product_id
columns.comment: Soft link to products.Product (optional dependency, no ref/picker to avoid a hard install requirement).

columns.name: asset_url
columns.label: link_marketing.field.asset_url
columns.comment: Authorized source photo/render the provider is allowed to use for mockups.

columns.name: authorized
columns.label: link_marketing.field.authorized
columns.comment: Must be true before any GenerationJob may reference this asset (checked by handle_Creative_request_generation).

columns.name: current_version
columns.label: link_marketing.field.current_version
columns.comment: Mirrors the highest CreativeVersion.version created for this creative; bumped on generation completion and on manual uploads.

columns.name: moderation_status
columns.label: link_marketing.field.moderation_status
columns.comment: Independent of lifecycle `status`: a creative can be approved for publication yet later flagged by moderation.

columns.name: generation_job_id
columns.label: link_marketing.field.generation_job_id
columns.comment: Lineage: which provider request produced this version, empty when source=uploaded.

columns.name: prompt_snapshot
columns.label: link_marketing.field.prompt_snapshot
columns.comment: Frozen copy of the prompt actually sent to the provider (brief + brand tone + rules), independent of later edits to Campaign.brief.

columns.name: product_reference_id
columns.label: link_marketing.field.product_reference_id
columns.comment: Lineage: authorized product asset used as mockup input, when any.

columns.name: provider_key
columns.label: link_marketing.field.provider_key
columns.comment: Logical id of the installed generation provider (e.g. a future 'nanobanana'). link_marketing never hardcodes a provider: any connector that declares capability 'marketing-generation-provider' and subscribes to marketing.generation_job.requested can serve a provider_key. Resolving provider_key -> installed connector is an ops/kernel routing concern, not this addon's.

columns.name: cost_amount
columns.label: link_marketing.field.cost_amount
columns.comment: Real cost reported by the provider callback (handle_GenerationJob_complete), not an estimate.

columns.name: provider_reference
columns.label: link_marketing.field.provider_reference
columns.comment: Provider-side job/request id, echoed back for support and reconciliation.
